To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the HITRANS 2012 water vapour absorption spectrum is a significant improvement compared to the 2009 version, but still contains systematic errors that can be reduced by scaling the absorption cross sections by factors ranging from about 0.5 (for the 426 nm band) to 1.5 (for 416 nm band).
the HITRANS 2012 and HITEMP water vapour absorption spectra are significantly improved compared to the HITRAN 09 version.
The absorption cross-section of H2O vap. is still not well known in the blue spectral range.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the improvement and verification of the water vapour absorption parameters for the UV-A spectral region, and we provide correction factors for the most commonly used water vapour spectroscopic databases.
the validation and improvement of water vapour absorption spectra for the blue spectral region.
the retrieval of H2O column densities from long-path and MAX-DOAS measurements in the blue wavelength region (394–480 nm).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the water vapour absorption bands at 394, 416 and 424 nm are still not well represented by the current spectroscopic databases and require further improvements.
the water vapour cross-sections in the 394–480nm range are still not sufficiently accurate for the purpose of atmospheric measurements and that further work is necessary to improve their quality.
all available water vapour absorption data compilations need significant corrections.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the water vapour absorption bands in the blue range should be scaled by a factor of 0.5–1.9.
for the blue spectral region the water vapour absorption strengths are overestimated by factors of 1–3, depending on the spectral region.
the absorption cross-sections of water vapour are still not well established and need to be further improved.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the water vapour absorption spectrum in the blue spectral region needs to be improved.
for the blue spectral range, HITRAN is not yet a reliable source of water vapour cross-sections, and that field measurements are required to improve the quality of the data.
